mapper.sql: SELECT c.comment_idx, c.post_idx, c.body_txt, c.created_by, COALESCE(um.user_name, c.created_by, '') AS author_nm, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM bbs_comment c LEFT JOIN user_mst um ON um.user_id = c.created_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs_comment (post_idx, body_txt, created_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{postIdx}, TRIM(#{bodyTxt}), #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
